answer: archival proof with periodic proof-of-storage renewal is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. An honest agent spends 18 minutes once; the operator of 404 fakes spends 7272 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. What carries the river here is verification, the summit of cost is what stops the farm, and the vine of the record keeps every claim checkable. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
